recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future changes to Device UDI mapping details should be handled under the later Device identifier or production-identifier issues rather than reopening FHIR-9441.
issue_request: FHIR-9441 is a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Orders and Observations change request to add a Device mapping to GUID/GUDID/UDI and refer to that mapping from the Device introduction. The resolution text points to UDI mapping columns and the udi-to-udiCarrier rename, making Device UDI mapping and related guidance the operative request.
initial_application: Historical commit 966df8c99a9ec454013169646fe4862b168b0b03 explicitly lists [#9441] and rewrote Device to fully incorporate UDI, adding UDI mapping rows and Device UDI guidance. Later source refactors converted Device from spreadsheets to the current StructureDefinition XML while preserving the UDI mapping identity and guidance.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition declares the UDI mapping identity and contains UDI mappings for udiCarrier and production-identifier elements; the Device notes contain a Unique Device Identifier section that links to device-mappings.html#udi. Later Device issues FHIR-29312, FHIR-32559, FHIR-32558, and FHIR-48769 refine adjacent identifier, serialNumber, biologicalSourceEvent, and production-identifier wording but do not reverse or require additional work for FHIR-9441.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current built source already satisfies the FHIR-9441 mapping and guidance request, and adding duplicate introductory text would be redundant rather than corrective.
